product.description: The TrailForge TrekPro 2.0 is engineered for serious hikers who demand durability and performance. Constructed from high‑strength aluminum alloy, the poles feature a telescoping mechanism that locks securely at 30‑cm increments, allowing quick adjustments for uneven terrain. A dual‑layer rubber grip offers a comfortable hold even in wet conditions, while a lightweight carbon‑fiber sleeve reduces overall weight to 0.8 kg. The poles are designed to be compatible with most trekking backpacks and can be used for trail running, mountaineering, or general outdoor excursions. With a maximum load capacity of 120 kg, the TrekPro 2.0 provides reliable support for long‑distance hikes and steep ascents.
